description: This file defines the interface for the Store class in the c10d distributed package, including core methods for key-value store operations, timeout management, and related utilities.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: An abstract base class for distributed key-value store implementations, providing core interface methods and default behaviors.

classes.name: StoreTimeoutGuard
classes.description: A RAII guard class that temporarily sets the store's timeout value and restores the previous value upon destruction.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a thread-safe copy of the store that points to the same underlying store.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key to a string value.

methods.name: set (overloaded)
methods.description: Sets a key to a binary value.

methods.name: std::vector<uint8_t> compareSet(const std::string & key,const std::vector<uint8_t> & currentValue,const std::vector<uint8_t> & newValue)
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap operation on a key's value.

methods.name: get_to_str
methods.description: Retrieves the string value associated with a key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the binary value associated with a key.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Atomically adds an integer value to the value stored at a key.

methods.name: deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the store.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks for the existence of multiple keys.

methods.name: getNumKeys
methods.description: Returns the total number of keys in the store.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the specified keys are available or the timeout elapses.

methods.name: wait (overloaded)
methods.description: Blocks until the specified keys are available or the specified timeout elapses.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns the current timeout setting for the store.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for operations on the store.

methods.name: void watchKey(const std::string &,WatchKeyCallback)
methods.description: Deprecated method to watch a key for changes.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a binary value to the existing value associated with a key.

methods.name: multiGet
methods.description: Retrieves multiple values for a list of keys.

methods.name: multiSet
methods.description: Sets multiple key-value pairs at once.

methods.name: hasExtendedApi
methods.description: Indicates whether the store supports extended features like append, multiGet, and multiSet.

methods.name: void queuePush(const std::string & key,const std::vector<uint8_t> & value)
methods.description: Pushes a value into a queue stored at a key.

methods.name: std::vector<uint8_t> queuePop(const std::string & key,bool block)
methods.description: Pops a value from a queue at a key.

methods.name: int64_t queueLen(const std::string & key)
methods.description: Returns the length of a queue at a key.

methods.name: std::vector<std::string> listKeys()
methods.description: Lists all keys in the store.

methods.name: Store()
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: Store(const std::chrono::milliseconds & timeout)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: StoreTimeoutGuard(Store & store,const std::chrono::milliseconds & timeout)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: ~StoreTimeoutGuard()
methods.description: unavailable

ctags.name: compareSet
ctags.signature: (const std::string & key,const std::vector<uint8_t> & currentValue,const std::vector<uint8_t> & newValue)

ctags.name: queuePop
ctags.pattern: /^  virtual std::vector<uint8_t> queuePop(const std::string& key, bool block) {$/
